Subject: Dedicated capacity recap — Aurora Health

Thanks for taking time earlier today, Alex — appreciate the deep dive. Below is a short recap from our call and proposed next steps so we're aligned.

TL;DR
- Aurora wants dedicated GPU capacity for production inference (isolation + predictable throughput)
- Primary goals: sub-100ms average gen latency for 2k-token prompts, sustained throughput ~200 requests/sec, predictable monthly unit costs and enterprise SLAs
- Next steps: Redwood provides draft SOW + capacity plan by EOD Tue (08/18), schedule technical deep-dive with infra/ops, procurement review for commercial terms

Key pain points you shared
- Current vendor variability: unpredictable latency spikes during peak batch windows impacting user experience
- Data isolation and auditability requirements (must meet FedRAMP-readiness and KMS-backed key management)
- Need predictable unit economics to model subscription pricing for downstream customers

Goals and acceptance criteria
- Isolation: fully dedicated GPU pool with VPC peering and customer-managed KMS (no multi-tenant sharing)
- Performance: p95 latency target <= 150ms and avg latency target <= 100ms for 2k-token gen; 200 sustained requests/sec with burst to 500 requests/sec for 10-minute windows
- Reliability: SLA target 99.95% monthly availability; 99th percentile token-generation latency SLO
- Scaling: start with reserved capacity (4 x A100 equivalent) with policy to autoscale to 16 within 10 minutes, and burst to 32 for scheduled events
- Observability & ops: per-request tracing, token-level cost breakdown, and audit logs retention for 12 months

Proposed capacity/architecture (initial recommendation)
- Reserved pool: 4x A100-class GPUs initially (predictable baseline)
- Autoscaling: policy-based vertical scaling to 16x within the same rented cluster; separate burst pool for scheduled events (up to 32x)
- Network/isolation: dedicated VPC, optional on-prem connector for sensitive workloads, KMS integration for key management

Commercial & procurement notes
- We'll produce a draft SOW with pricing tiers for reserved capacity + burst usage. Pricing will be usage + reservation blended to reduce unit costs at baseline
- Typical minimum term for Dedicated is 12 months with monthly commit options; we can discuss annual pricing as well

Attachments sent: Aurora_Dedicated_SOW_v1.pdf (outline SOW) and aurora_capacity_plan.xlsx (rough sizing / cost model)

Next steps (owner / ETA)
- Marissa: Send final draft SOW + capacity plan by EOD Tue 08/18 (deliverable attached)
- Connor / Dev: Tech deep-dive to validate sizing and integration requirements (schedule this week)
- Alex: Loop in procurement contact for contract review (if not already done)

If anything above is off or missing, let me know and I'll update. Thanks again — looking forward to moving this forward.
